# --help points to the docs, and explains BUILD.bit with an example whose
# sections are set apart by blank lines.
bit --help
stdout 'Use --docs to read the full documentation'
stdout 'See `bit --docs ci`'
stdout 'BUILD\.bit example \(illustrative\):'
stdout 'import "\./modules/app" as app'
stdout 'import "github\.com/acme/build" as tools'
stdout 'param version: string = "dev"'
stdout 'name: string = "Bob", retries = 2, age: int = null'
stdout 'binary\[arch\] = go\.exe'
stdout 'group default = \[binary\]'
stdout 'output artifact = binary\["amd64"\]\.path'
stdout 'Use --schema to list all available resources and functions\.'
stdout '\n\n  param version'
stdout '\n\n  let arch'
stdout '\n\n  binary\[arch\]'
stdout '\n\n  output artifact'
